Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Prem Narayan Tiwari,Rajat Agarwal,Sanjiv Kumar Dwivedi,Virprata

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.

Heard Sri Prem Narayan Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
This applicant has been filed with a prayer to release the applicant on bail in case crime No. 580 of 2021, under sections 376-D, 323, 506 IPC and section 67 of I.T. Act, P.S. Swar, District Rampur.
It is contended by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case due to village partibandi.
Further contended that in the present case the victim is major, married and insane.
Also according to medical examination report there is no injury on the body of the victim.

There is gross contradiction in the prosecution case and the statement of the victim recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. and lastly argued that applicant is in jail since 9.12.2021 having no criminal history.

Per contra learned A.G.A. for the State rebutted the above arguments stating that applicant-accused is named in the FIR along with other co-accused, who have been committed gang rape with the Furkan Ali vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145680494/

sentences.text: married lady, also prepared the video clip of the incident and in the statement of the victim is intact as recorded under section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
The complicity of the applicant is proved and the gravity of the offence is too much

Having considered the submissions raised by the counsel for the applicant-accused and the objections raised by learned A.G.A. for the State, gravity and severity of the offence and conduct of the applicant-accused, I am of the view that prima facie at this stage grounds are not sufficient to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
Accordingly, prayer for bail is refused.
